name: Мат в один хід (4)
description:
Is the opponentâs king vulnerable? Look for checkmate! Deliver checkmate by placing the king in check while controlling all its escape squares.

Did you know that no chess piece can deliver checkmate alone? Even the queen cannot checkmate by itself, not even when the enemy king is in the corner. To deliver checkmate, multiple pieces must work together. Sometimes the checkmating piece needs protection. In other cases, multiple pieces cooperate to control all escape squares. Occasionally, an opponentâs piece might block their own kingâs escape.

examples.text: A position with a unique checkmate pattern! By moving the black knight to the center, White is in check, and all escape squares are covered.
The black king is far advanced, and White can take advantage of this by giving a check with the queen. Suddenly, the king has no escape.
